title: Lost Classics
description:
S1 E1 — Unboxing a Mustang
Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle.

title: Lost Classics
description:
S1 E2 — Love Hurst
A Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop.

title: Lost Classics
description:
S1 E3 — Oddballs and Icons
Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's too good of a deal to pass up.

description:
